notes: Seed affordance: re-confirmed the Profile 'Load my 7 Nov session' button is reachable (its guard keys on whether the session is already in the log, not on the flag boot() sets before first paint)
Override schema: removed the dead 'rename override' field — exName never read overrides.n (renames live on custom exercises)
Work time %: the dashboard chip and the Stamina explainer now name their window (all-time vs the last 28 days) so two different numbers no longer share one label
Volume & recovery: a Sets / Tonnage / Reps toggle now plots the weekly tonnage and reps the engine already computes — no second tonnage calculation
Docs: the vault note no longer claims a rest timer, plate/warm-up calculators, super/drop/failure set types or routines — none exist in the app (the README was already accurate)
The first-run tour version is now injected from android/version.properties at build time (loud failure if the anchor is missing), so it can no longer silently stop re-showing
Accessibility: visible keyboard focus ring, modal role=dialog + aria-modal + background scroll lock, toasts are an aria-live region, and set-row inputs are labelled for screen readers
